artifact_observations.reasoning: The 'stones' on the leaf pendant lack distinct individual facets or boundaries, appearing as a continuous noisy texture rather than discrete gems. This is a common AI artifact where complex repetitive details merge.
The connection point where the pendant attaches to the bead strand is visually ambiguous and lacks a clear mechanical loop or bail structure, appearing slightly fused.
The left edge of the mannequin shows slight warping and softness inconsistent with a rigid plastic display form.

Also, inspect the texture of the paved stones on the leaf; they often melt into a single noisy patch in AI generations.
